precedence: This append-only clarification narrows implementation authority and resolves the listed ambiguities. It does not alter any other callback carrier or manifest rule and grants no full HRM-013 module authority.

idempotency.idempotencyKey: canonical lowercase 36-character UUID text of approvalRequestId

grantDigest.canonicalValues: UUIDs are lowercase canonical text; positive integers are base-10 ASCII without sign or leading zero; decision and protocol constants retain their exact sealed ASCII spelling; recorded_at is UTC RFC3339 with exactly six fractional digits and Z; null supersedes_grant_id is encoded as a zero-length value and no other field may be null.
grantDigest.encoding: For each ordered value, encode its canonical value as UTF-8, prefix it with an unsigned 32-bit big-endian byte length, then concatenate all fifteen length-value pairs with no delimiter or trailing bytes.
grantDigest.digestRule: grant_digest is SHA-256 over exactly the resulting byte sequence. Platform-default charset, delimiter joining, JSON serialization and ambiguous null text are forbidden.

stepUp.rejectedRule: All seven wire fields are absent and all seven storage columns are null; explicit null wire fields are invalid.
stepUp.freshnessEvidence: Existing dwp-approval-server application.yml freezes dwp.approval.step-up.maximum-authentication-age-seconds default at 600; this prerequisite may consume that existing value but may not edit configuration.
stepUp.freshnessRule: stepUpVerifiedAt <= stepUpConsumedAt <= decision_occurred_at and decision_occurred_at minus stepUpVerifiedAt is at most 600 seconds.
stepUp.storage: Persist evidence identity, audience, purpose, SHA-256 of the nonce, evidence digest, verified time and consumed time in apr_hrm013_waiver_decision_outbox; raw nonce exists only in immutable exact_callback_body.
stepUp.singleUse: The tenant-scoped evidence identity and nonce digest are consumed atomically with the terminal APPROVED row.

retry.exhaustion: RESULT_UNKNOWN when remote commit is ambiguous, otherwise DEAD

hrm010Revision.rule: One approvalRequestId is one terminal stream. APPROVED or REJECTED closes revision 1; a later attempt uses a new approvalRequestId and a new revision-one stream.

controlPlaneAuthorityPort.admission: Require one current authoritative ADMIT result with exact equality for both signed revisions before any business-row read.
forbiddenFallbacks: protocol-fence row as a substitute for current control-plane authority
controlPlaneAuthorityPort.testDoubleRule: A deterministic fake may exist only in test source; no production credential, provider implementation or bean binding is authorized.
